registry_changes: Bumped version from h3-2 to canary-1.
Added timeline to partner.uses, retaining recorded and linked.
Expanded partner.definition to cover the user's own dating relationships, former partners, explicit denials, stated date precision, overlaps and reunion episodes.
Changed partner.exclusive to false so explicit overlapping relationships do not imply a unique holder.
Retained partner.succession=true and slot=null: one succession track, independent of girlfriend, boyfriend or spouse labels, subject to the documented succession safeguards.
Set partner.gap_months=12. Longer gaps require a gap explanation rather than naming a predecessor or successor; corresponding fixture answers are empty.
Expanded partner.query_cues with English dating and breakup expressions and Spanish accented and unaccented equivalents.
Retained the existing partner lexicon, label qualifier and answer phrases. All other predicates and shared configuration are unchanged.
